layers.star: Gold charm on the flopped hat tip: G/Y/L pixels with x<=8 and y<=9. Nine pixels. Pendulum pivot (7,7).
layers.hat: y<=11 except star pixels. Translates with the body. Hat rotation (ha) is implemented but kept at 0; small rotations punched holes in the flopped brim.
layers.feet: y>=34. Anchored; never translated or rotated.
layers.staff: x>=26 and y>=15. Isolated right-hand cluster: wooden shaft, cyan orb, and the OPPO/OSSO grip. Pivot (27,25) sits on the grip.
layers.body: Remainder: face, cowl, robe, belt, idle left arm. Translates with the cast but does not rotate.

notes: Do not reuse the cleric rectangle mask. Flood-filling from the orb with x>=22 leaked into the right robe wall.
x>=26 is the first clean cut: hat maxX is 25, and the staff/grip cluster begins at x=26.
Positive staff angle uses the cleric convention and swings the orb forward (right).
Spell pixels use only colors already in the wizard sprite: cyan C, orb highlight Q, cream L, gold Y/G.
